decisions.breakingRequirement: 'Audit normalized.csv, audit.md, and verify_ledger.py against that fresh result, including survivor completeness, arithmetic, raw-versus-surviving separation ... and nonzero verifier behavior on disagreement. Correct any defect in those same files'
decisions.label: other
decisions.reason: [SAME index 1] In this run, the model wrote the three files in the previous phase, in a format P does not know. P cannot audit the claims in an LLM-written audit.md or the logic of an LLM-written verifier. The same recipe's later subtasks (3b3efaf3, 947a21a2), which the judge rated PARTIAL or NOT with the label contract/schema design, show exactly this parsing problem. All P can do is overwrite the three files with its own output. Overwriting is not 'correct any defect in those same files': it discards correct existing content, and the audit is never performed, including the nonzero behaviour of the existing verifier. This follows group C's own rule that existing LLM-authored artefacts lie outside S. The recomputation, the final verifier run and the returned conclusions are parametric. This is the WEAKEST of the four downgrades: if wholesale regeneration counts as correction, the subtask goes back to COVERED. The recipe stays NOT either way.

decisions.breakingRequirement: 'report.md must explain feasibility, cost calculations, rigorous optimality certificates, and uniqueness'
decisions.label: content/design authoring
decisions.reason: [SAME index 0] This is a report with reasoning, and no schema field carries it. The judge's P offers an 'enumeration certificate', which is the same exhaustive enumeration that verify_transport.py is separately required to perform 'independently'. The report therefore contains no certificate a reader can check, and the independence between report and verifier that the subtask sets up collapses into one computation. An optimality certificate for a capacitated transportation problem (dual potentials, reduced costs, a dual for the B->Y capacity) needs a domain algorithm that the subtask names only by the phrase 'rigorous optimality certificates'. It is in neither S nor the judge's P, so it is also algorithm/business-rule. A P with an LP-dual engine could arguably close the gap; that is the sensitivity of this decision. Checked by brute force: both scenarios have a unique optimum (cap 4: cost 89, [[5,2,0],[3,4,2],[0,0,8]] out of 105 feasible matrices; cap 5: cost 85, [[6,1,0],[2,5,2],[0,0,8]] out of 110). solution.json and the verifier therefore stay parametric, and 'Using the established solution', a prior phase that is not in the text, is harmless only because the optimum is unique.

decisions.label: content/design authoring
decisions.reason: [SAME index 0] This is reasoning prose, and no schema field carries it. The judge's P (an SVG writer, an a+b*pi metric engine and an XML verifier) computes the centroid as a number from moments. A symmetry argument (hole-nw/ne and sw/se mirrored about x=60, hole-nw/sw mirrored about y=40, the slot centred at (60,40), hence the centroid) is not an output of that computation. A templated sentence asserting symmetry is content written for this subtask unless P also carries a symmetry detector, and neither S nor the judge's P includes one. Secondary: 'Include an accessible title and description' gives no wording. That point is minor because it can be templated. Everything else is literal and covered: coordinates, styles, the six elements, the forbidden content, the expected values and tolerance, and the r=4 negative test. Values checked: area 6000-224-52pi = 5776-52pi, perimeter 320+24pi+56+8pi = 376+32pi, minimum clearance 7.

notes: Result: 13 CONFIRMED and 4 DOWNGRADED, all to PARTIAL and none to NOT. COVERED falls from 17 to 13. Over the 119 SAME subtasks in the four group files, that is 10.9% (it was 14.3%). Only 11 distinct texts are covered, because 72e81903 and the http-replay text are each counted twice. PARAMETRIC recipes fall from 7 to 4: sync-docs (0 credited), csv-statistics (1 credited, a routing mismatch), http-replay (1 credited) and schema-csv-json (5 credited, 2 of them SAME). No recipe has >= 5 credited SAME successes. BUILD is therefore unreachable under any reading, since it needs 3 such recipes. The share sits in the 10-25% 'pilot on the single best recipe' band by about one subtask (the 10% line is 11.9/119), so these sensitivities decide which band applies. (a) Two COVERED subtasks are borderline SAME: B1 a05c004c (no resource) and the C cc7ed6f1 observations.csv fix-up (a literal file rewrite). If both are OTHER, the share is 11/117 = 9.4%, which is DO NOT BUILD. (b) Reverting the weakest downgrade (ledger c21011cb index 1) gives 14/119 = 11.8%. (c) A population defect that cuts the other way, NOT applied here because it is a correction to the population and not a verdict: the protocol's cap of 7 subtasks per recipe is exceeded in 5 recipes. They are A build-self-contained-static-page (8), A patch-verified-static-ui (10), A build-node-api-web-ui (11), C build-exact-ledger-reconciler (11) and C build-text-frequency-cli (10). Every SAME subtask in them is PARTIAL or NOT, so a strict cap would shrink the denominator by roughly 10-12 and raise the share to about 12%. The main analysis should apply (a) and (c) explicitly rather than leave them implicit. Systemic caveats, which are not used as refutations: (1) In PCM, ZIP, the ledger, transport and vector, the generator and the 'independent' verifier are instantiated from one extracted S, so an extraction error is common-mode. These subtasks define independence at the code level (no import, no reuse of the generator's data), which P meets. (2) Most schemas were fitted after the fact to n=1-2 texts. Enum values mirror the one text they came from (probeCases, readmeForbiddenClaims, auditSections, the CSV rule vocabulary, the modes), so the next match is untested. (3) A requirement such as 'via the write_file tool' assumes the dispatcher writes P's output through elements. Method: each of the 17 texts was read in full from the group files. None was truncated, so no MCP call was made. The transport optima were checked by brute force, and the ledger survivors and geometry values were checked by hand.
